w10_P4_001348: A 173 000 g pallet is accelerated on a distribution-centre conveyor. The controller sets the acceleration, in m/s², by taking the area under the curve y = 3x² + 7x from x = 0 to x = 1, subtracting 14, and then adding 27. The centre runs 3 identical conveyors, each with one such pallet, at once. What total force, in N, do the 3 conveyors supply?
w10_P4_001350: A 196 000 g elevator car is accelerated upward by its hoist, with gravity balanced by a counterweight. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 0·x² is itself changing at x = 3. The shaft is 80 m tall. The hoist force is expressed in kilonewtons, and 27 kN is added as a brake reserve. The building has 5 such cars, and the developer owns 11 identical buildings. What is the total rated hoist force, in kN, across all buildings?
w10_P4_001357: A rail engineer wants the net energy figure, in kilojoules, for a test: it is the combined energy of motion of 8 identical model wagons, expressed in kilojoules, minus 18 kJ absorbed by the buffers, minus 22 kJ lost in the brakes. Each model wagon has a mass of 43 kg and is 1.5 m long. Each wagon's speed, in m/s, equals the area under the curve y = 2x² + 6x from x = 0 to x = 2. What is the net energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001360: A 40 000 g cart on a workshop floor moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the area under the curve y = 4x² + 3x from x = 0 to x = 1. The carts are driven by a shared belt. The workshop runs 11 identical carts at once, and a spring launcher adds 27 J to their combined energy of motion. Express the combined energy of motion in kJ.
w10_P4_001366: A 172 000 g crate is accelerated on a loading dock at a rate, in m/s², equal to the smaller root of x² - 9x + 8 = 0. The dock motor must also overcome 22 N of floor friction and 8 N of air drag. The motor's force is expressed in kilonewtons, and the dock runs 6 identical motors at once. What total force, in kN, do the motors supply?
w10_P4_001368: A 22 kg robot is accelerated across a warehouse floor at a rate, in m/s², equal to the area under the curve y = 2x² + 1·x from x = 0 to x = 2. The floor is 40 m long. The warehouse runs 12 identical robots at once, and a shared cable adds 14 N of drag. Express the total force, in kN, that the drive system must supply.
w10_P4_001370: A depot wants the total force, in kilonewtons, for 8 bays, each with 6 identical 70 000 g carts, each cart's force being stated in kilonewtons. The carts' acceleration, in m/s², is 8 more than the smaller root of x² - 13x + 42 = 0. All the carts start moving at once. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001371: A 15 kg model boat is pushed forward by its propeller at an acceleration, in m/s², equal to the number of ways to choose 4 flags from 7. The forward force is expressed in kilonewtons. A 24 kN forward tow line is then added, after which an 8 kN backward drag and a 21 kN backward anchor pull act on the boat. What is the net forward force, in kN, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_001380: A quarry wants the total force, in kilonewtons, for 5 pits, each with 8 identical loaders. Each loader's force is what accelerates its 193 000 g bucket, plus 14 N of hinge friction. The bucket's acceleration, in m/s², equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 5x³ + 1·x² is itself changing at x = 2. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001382: A 44 kg sled moves along a rail at a speed, in m/s, equal to the area under the curve y = 5x² + 5x from x = 0 to x = 3. The rail is 60 m long. The sled's energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules; it then loses 21 kJ to a brake and 9 kJ to air drag. What energy of motion, in kJ, remains?
w10_P4_001389: A 102 000 g cart is accelerated at a rate, in m/s², equal to the number of ways to choose 4 wheels from 7. The cart is 1.2 m long. The fleet has 11 depots, each with 11 lines, each with 10 identical carts, all accelerating at once. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001390: A physics teacher wants a final figure, in joules: 1 J stored in the launcher's latch, plus the combined energy of motion of 4 lanes of 12 identical 10 kg carts. The track is 6 m long. Each cart's speed, in m/s, is 8 times the greatest common divisor of 188 and 368. What is the final figure, in J?
w10_P4_001396: A 60 000 g press ram moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the smaller root of x² - 15x + 56 = 0. The press operates at 220 bar. The press makes 12 strokes per part, and the per-part total of the ram's energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules. The shop makes 3 parts per shift and runs 11 shifts. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ, delivered over the 11 shifts?
w10_P4_001399: A 118 000 g cart is accelerated on a test rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the area under the curve y = 5x² + 6x from x = 1 to x = 3. The rail is 25 m long. The force is expressed in kilonewtons, and 16 kN is added as a safety margin. The rail has 4 identical carts, and a 21 kN reserve is added to the combined figure. What is the final rating, in kN?
w10_P4_001411: A coach wants the total energy of motion, in joules, of 10 squads of 11 identical sleds. Each sled has a mass of 28 kg and is 1.3 m long. Each sled's speed, in m/s, is 3 times the smaller root of x² - 11x + 30 = 0. What is the total energy of motion, in J?
w10_P4_001421: A 147 kg hovercraft model is pushed forward on a test pond at an acceleration, in m/s², equal to 4 times the sum of 3 and 7. The pond is 30 m wide. The forward force is expressed in kilonewtons, and a 20 kN backward tether then acts on the model. The test runs 12 identical models. What is the net forward force, in kN, across all 12, with backward forces counted as negative?
w10_P4_001434: A depot wants the rated force, in kilonewtons, for a wagon hoist: a 1 kN reserve plus the force to accelerate a 157 000 g wagon, expressed in kilonewtons. The acceleration, in m/s², is found by taking the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 4x² at x = 1, multiplying it by 5, and subtracting 19. Gravity is balanced by a counterweight. What is the rated force, in kN?
w10_P4_001435: A 73 kg crate is accelerated on a conveyor at a rate, in m/s², that is 24 more than 5 times the sum of 2 and 8. The plant runs 11 identical crates at once. A tailwind adds 27 N to the total force, and a slope removes 30 N. What is the total force, in N?
w10_P4_001439: A lab wants the total force, in kilonewtons, for 4 benches, each with 3 identical 9 kg carts, with each cart's force stated in kilonewtons. The benches are 2 m long. Each cart's acceleration, in m/s², equals the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ - 1·x² at x = 2. What is the total force, in kN?
w10_P4_001441: A tram engineer wants the rated force, in kilonewtons: a 27 kN reserve added to the force for a 159 kg bogie, expressed in kilonewtons, after 7 N is removed for a regenerative assist and 2 N is added for coupler drag. The bogie is 2.5 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², is 8 times the sum of 2 and 7. What is the rated force, in kN?
w10_P4_001442: A 57 000 g mail cart rolls at a speed, in m/s, equal to the smaller root of x² - 8x + 7 = 0. The corridor is 30 m long. The post office runs 10 identical carts at once; the group loses 25 J of its energy of motion to a door threshold. The result is expressed in kilojoules, and a lift adds 10 kJ. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001445: A lab wants the total energy of motion, in kilojoules, of 12 sets of 4 identical 10 000 g carts, with each set's figure expressed in kilojoules. Each cart's speed, in m/s, is 6 more than the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ - 5x² at x = 3. The carts run on an air track. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ?
w10_P4_001451: A fleet engineer wants the net force, in newtons, on a cart after 21 N of drag is removed, before which 28 N of tailwind was added, and before that 6 N was recovered by a regenerative unit from the force needed to accelerate the 112 kg cart. The acceleration, in m/s², is the smaller root of x² - 14x + 48 = 0. What is the net force, in N?
w10_P4_001453: A 22 000 g cart rolls at a speed, in m/s, equal to the greatest common divisor of 350 and 236. Its energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules. A heater adds 21 kJ and a spring adds 10 kJ to the cart's energy account. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001455: A depot wants the total force, in newtons, for 4 identical carts, each with 18 N of tailwind added after 1 N is recovered by a regenerative unit from the force needed to accelerate its 187 000 g mass. The acceleration, in m/s², is the slope of the curve y = 2x³ - 5x² at x = 2. What is the total force, in N?
